app.name: Mirador
app.tagline: Know where you stand. See where you're going.

home.title: Your money at a glance
home.body: How this period is going, your goals and anything that needs a look will show up here.

budget.title: Your budget is on its way
budget.body: It will grow from your own spending habits, one small step at a time.

settings.encrypted: Your data is end-to-end encrypted. Only this device can read it while it's unlocked.

account.title: Account
account.description: Your profile picture and username, and deleting your account.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Choose light or dark and the app's colors on this device.
appearance.categoryNote: Your category colors stay the same in every palette.

language.title: Language
language.description: Choose the language Mirador speaks on this device.
language.deviceNote: This setting is for this device only.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: New wallets start with it and every total is shown in it.

install.title: Add to Home Screen
install.summary: Open Mirador full screen, like an app
install.intro: Mirador will open from its own icon, full screen, without the browser's bars.

ios.share: Tap Share in the browser's toolbar
ios.add: Scroll down and tap Add to Home Screen

android.add: Tap Add to Home screen or Install app

profile.pictureIntro: It shows at the top of every page. Keep your initial or pick an icon.

signUp.title: Pick a profile picture
signUp.intro: It shows at the top of every page. You can change it any time in Settings.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.intro: Your password unlocks your data on this device. It never leaves it.
signIn.passkey: Sign in with Face ID or a passkey
signIn.deleted: Your account and all its data were deleted from this server.

signUp.title: Create your account
signUp.intro: Your password encrypts your data on this device. The server never sees it, so nobody can reset it for you.
signUp.usernameHint: 3 to 32 letters, numbers, dots, dashes or underscores. It doesn't need to be your real name.
signUp.passwordHint: At least {{count}} characters, with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter, a number and a symbol.
signUp.setupCodeHint: This server has no accounts yet. The person who runs it finds the setup code in the server's log.
signUp.inviteCodeHint: This server takes new accounts by invite only. The code is in the link you were sent; if you have none, ask the person who runs the server.

recoveryKey.title: Save your recovery key
recoveryKey.intro: If you forget your password, this key is the only way back into your data. It's shown only this once.
recoveryKey.warning: If you lose both your password and this key, your data is gone for good. Nobody can recover it, not even the person who runs the server.
recoveryKey.label: Recovery key
recoveryKey.confirm: I saved my recovery key somewhere safe

unlock.title: Unlock Mirador
unlock.intro: Your data is encrypted. Enter your password to open it on this device.
unlock.introPasskey: Your data is encrypted. Use Face ID, a passkey or your password to open it on this device.
unlock.passkey: Unlock with Face ID or a passkey

recover.title: Recover your account
recover.intro: Your recovery key opens your data and sets a new password. Every other device will be signed out.
recover.recoveryKeyHint: The key you saved when you created your account. Spaces and dashes don't matter.
recover.working: Opening your data with the recovery key…

settings.title: Password and security
settings.description: Your password, passkeys and recovery key, and when this device locks.

username.title: Username
username.intro: You sign in as {{username}}. A new username keeps your password, passkeys and data as they are.
username.done: Username changed. Sign in as {{username}} from now on.

password.title: Password
password.intro: Your password unlocks your data. Changing it signs out your other devices, and your data stays as it is.
password.done: Password changed. Your other devices were signed out.

recoveryKey.title: Recovery key
recoveryKey.intro: Make a new recovery key if you lost yours or someone else may have seen it. The old one stops working at once.
recoveryKey.done: Your new recovery key is saved. The old one no longer works.

devices.title: Other devices
devices.intro: Sign out every other phone, tablet or computer. This one stays signed in.
devices.done_zero: No other devices were signed in.

passkeys.title: Passkeys and Face ID
passkeys.intro: Unlock and sign in with Face ID, a fingerprint or your device's PIN instead of typing your password. Your password keeps working.
passkeys.name: Passkey {{number}}
passkeys.done: Passkey added. Next time, unlock with it.
passkeys.unsupported: This browser can't use passkeys. Try Safari on an iPhone or Chrome on Android.

autoLock.title: Lock automatically
autoLock.intro: Mirador locks itself when you stop using it, and asks for your password, Face ID or passkey again. This setting is for this device only.
autoLock.label: Lock
autoLock.leave: As soon as I leave the app

delete.title: Delete account
delete.intro: Deletes your account and all your data from this server for good. Nobody can undo it, not even the person who runs the server. Server backups may keep a copy until they expire.
delete.operator: You run this server. The oldest other account will run it after you. With no other accounts, the server waits for a new first account.

invites.title: Invites
invites.description: Only people you invite can create an account on this server.
invites.intro: Make an invite link and send it to them yourself. Each link works once, for {{count}} days.
invites.shareText: Track your expenses and plan your future with Mirador Budget:
invites.shownOnce: Send this link now: it is shown only once. If you lose it, withdraw the invite and make another.

checks.usernameCharacters: Only letters, numbers, dots, dashes or underscores

errors.username-taken: That username is taken. Pick another.
errors.wrong-setup-code: That setup code is wrong. Check the server's log for the current one.
errors.signed-out: You were signed out. Sign in again.
errors.locked: Mirador is locked. Unlock it with your password.
errors.too-many-attempts: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.unsafe-server: The server sent keys, settings or data that aren't safe, so Mirador stopped. Your password was not sent.
errors.network: Can't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.invalidUsername: Use 3 to 32 letters, numbers, dots, dashes or underscores, with no spaces.
errors.usernameMismatch: Type your username exactly as shown.
errors.passwordRules: Use at least {{count}} characters, with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter, a number and a symbol.
errors.recovery-key-typo: That recovery key has a typo. Check each group of four characters.
errors.wrong-invite: That invite code is wrong, already used or expired. Ask for a new one.
errors.wrong-passkey: That passkey isn't one of this account's, or it was removed. Use your password instead.
errors.passkey-unsupported: This passkey can't unlock encrypted data. Use one saved in iCloud Keychain, Google Password Manager or another passkey app that supports it.
errors.passkey-cancelled: The passkey wasn't used. Try again when you're ready.
errors.too-many-passkeys: This account already has as many passkeys as it can. Remove one first.

empty.title: A clear view starts here
empty.body: Add your first wallet and everything you have shows up in one place.

wallets.saveFailed: Couldn't save. Check your connection and try again.

missing.title: Wallet not found
missing.body: It may have been deleted on another device.

interest.title: Interest
interest.body: See what it earns or costs each month.

fees.title: Fees
fees.body: Get reminded of fees, like a monthly or annual fee.

creditLimit.title: Credit limit
creditLimit.body: See what's left to spend, when the statement closes and when to pay.

loanSchedule.title: Loan schedule
loanSchedule.body: See when it's paid off and how much interest is left.

valuations.title: Market value
valuations.body: Its value moves with the market. See your gain or loss apart from what you put in.

liquid.title: Available now
liquid.body: Money you can use today, like cash or a debit account. Leave it off for investments or retirement savings.

form.name: Name
form.balanceHint: Saved as the opening balance, dated today. You can change both later.
form.balanceInvalid: That isn't an amount. Type only numbers, like 1250.50.
form.currencyDecimals: It has a different number of decimals, so this wallet's amounts would change.
form.activeHint: Inactive wallets are hidden when you add transactions, and still count in net worth.
form.discardMessage: Your changes to this wallet won't be saved.
form.defaultHint: New transactions start in this wallet. You can still pick another one each time.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.message_one: This also deletes its one transaction. This can't be undone.
delete.message_other: This also deletes its {{count}} transactions. This can't be undone.

balance.label: Balance
balance.title: Update balance
balance.intro: Mirador has {{balance}}. Type the balance you see now.
balance.willAdjust: An adjustment of {{amount}} will be added today.
balance.matches: That's what Mirador has. Nothing to adjust.

transactions.title: Transactions
transactions.dateFuture: That date is in the future. Pick today or earlier.
transactions.openingHint: Move it back to when your records start to load older history.
transactions.emptyBody: Its balance starts at zero. Update it to match what you see in your bank.

reorder.title: Reorder wallets
reorder.intro: Drag the handles to put your wallets in the order you like.

credit.title: Credit limit
credit.empty: Add the limit and the statement days to see what's left to spend and when to pay.
credit.hint: Days run 1 to 31; in shorter months, the last day counts.
credit.invalid: Type a limit above zero and days from 1 to 31.

loan.title: Loan
loan.empty: Add the contract's amount, rate and term to see when it's paid off.
loan.never: A payment of {{payment}} doesn't cover the {{interest}} of interest each month, so this loan never gets paid off.
loan.noRate: Without a rate, this assumes no interest.
loan.invalid: Fill in the amount, rate, term and payment day.
loan.suggested: Leave the payment empty to use {{amount}}, worked out from the rate.

interest.title: Interest
interest.empty: Add the rate to see what this balance earns or costs each month.
interest.intro: The annual rate, as your bank quotes it.
interest.typeHint: Use the one on your statement. Savings show an effective rate, like the GAT, which already counts the interest earned on interest. Cards and loans show a nominal yearly rate.

valuation.title: Investment
valuation.hint: Each time you check what it's worth, tap Update value. Mirador shows the change as a gain or loss, apart from the money you put in.
valuation.intro: Mirador has {{balance}}. Type what it's worth now.
valuation.willChange: This records a market change of {{amount}}.

fees.title: Fees
fees.empty: Add fees such as an annual fee, and Mirador asks you to confirm each one when it's charged.
fees.invalid: Type a name and an amount above zero.
fees.hint: Charges before today count as paid; Mirador asks about each one after.
fees.name: Name
fees.notePlaceholder: Like: waived if I use the card every month

transactions.amountMissing: Type an amount above zero, like 45.50.
transactions.walletMissing: Pick the wallet it came from.
transactions.toMissing: Pick the wallet the money goes to.
transactions.receivedMissing: Type what arrived, or the exchange rate.
transactions.rateHint: Type what arrived or the exchange rate, and the other is worked out.
transactions.excludedHint: It still counts in the wallet's balance.
transactions.discardEdit: Your changes to this transaction won't be saved.

empty.title: A blank page, for now
empty.body: Every expense, income and transfer will show up here, newest first. Start with the last thing you paid for.

noWallets.title: First, a wallet
noWallets.body: Every transaction comes out of a wallet or goes into one. Add the one you use most, like your cash or your debit card.

rates.title: Exchange rate
rates.prompt: To count this wallet in your net worth, Mirador needs the exchange rate. You can also add it later on the wallet's page or in Settings > Currency.
rates.intro: The rate your bank or exchange office gives for {{currency}}. Each one is kept with its date.
rates.hint: Totals use the newest rate up to today.
rates.invalid: Type a rate above zero, like 18.45.
rates.deleteMessage: Totals will use the rate before it.
rates.missing: No rate yet, so it isn't in net worth
rates.missingWallet: No exchange rate yet, so it isn't in your net worth.

reorder.help: Use the up and down arrow keys to move it.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Categories say what money went to; category groups gather them for the budget and reports.

flexibility.lockedHint: Can’t change month to month, like rent or insurance. The budget never suggests cutting it.
flexibility.fixedHint: Needed, but the amount moves a little, like groceries or electricity. The budget keeps it steady.
flexibility.flexibleHint: Up to you, like eating out or hobbies. This is where the budget looks for room to save.

starter.title: Start with categories
starter.body: Pick a ready-made set you can change any time, or start with only the few built-in ones and add your own.

form.name: Name
form.nameTaken: {{group}} already has a category with this name.
form.groupMissing: Pick the category group it belongs to.
form.colorHint: It takes its category group’s color.
form.descriptionPlaceholder: What goes here, if it helps
form.archivedHint: Hidden when you pick a category; past transactions keep it.
form.deleteInUse_one: {{count}} transaction uses it. Move it to another category first, or archive this one to keep it.
form.deleteInUse_other: {{count}} transactions use it. Move them to another category first, or archive this one to keep them.
form.discard: Your changes to this category won’t be saved.

group.name: Name
group.nameMissing: Give the category group a name.
group.nameTaken: There’s already a category group with this name.
group.reorderIntro: Drag the handles to order the categories in {{name}}.
group.reorderAllIntro: Drag the handles to put your category groups in the order you like.
group.archivedHint: Hides the group and its categories when you pick one; past transactions keep them.
group.deleteHint: Move or delete its categories first; a category group can only be deleted when it’s empty.
group.discard: Your changes to this category group won’t be saved.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Tags add any detail a category doesn’t, like who it was with or which trip it was for. A transaction can have several.
tags.none: No tags yet. Type one to add it.

form.name: Name
form.nameTaken: There’s already a tag with this name.
form.archivedHint: Hidden when you pick tags; past transactions keep it.
form.deleteInUse_one: It will be removed from {{count}} transaction. The transaction stays.
form.deleteInUse_other: It will be removed from {{count}} transactions. The transactions stay.
form.discard: Your changes to this tag won’t be saved.

payees.none: No payees yet. Type one to add it.

filters.title: Filter
filters.amountHint: Amounts are compared in each wallet’s own currency.

recurring.title: Recurring
recurring.timesMissing: Type how many times, from 1 to 999.
recurring.askHint: It waits for you to check the amount, for bills that change. Otherwise it's added on its day.
recurring.editHint: Changes apply from now on; what was already added stays as it is.

empty.title: Nothing repeats yet
empty.body: Choose Repeat when you add a transaction, like rent or a subscription.

recurring.endsBeforeStart: It has to end after it starts.

installments.title: Pay in installments
installments.hint: Pay it one part each month.
installments.hintCard: The card bills it one part each month.
installments.summaryFree: {{monthly}} a month for {{months}} months, from the {{date}} statement. All {{total}} comes off your available credit at once.
installments.summaryInterest: {{monthly}} a month for {{months}} months, from the {{date}} statement: {{interest}} of interest, {{total}} in all. All of it comes off your available credit at once.
installments.summaryFreeDateCard: {{monthly}} a month for {{months}} months, from {{date}}. All {{total}} comes off your available credit at once.
installments.summaryInterestDateCard: {{monthly}} a month for {{months}} months, from {{date}}: {{interest}} of interest, {{total}} in all. All of it comes off your available credit at once.
installments.summaryFreeDate: {{monthly}} a month for {{months}} months, from {{date}}. Each one leaves this wallet on its day.
installments.summaryInterestDate: {{monthly}} a month for {{months}} months, from {{date}}: {{interest}} of interest, {{total}} in all.
installments.paymentMissing: Type the monthly payment you were quoted.
installments.paymentLow: The payments add up to less than the price.
installments.payOffBody: The {{amount}} still to come is paid today.
installments.payOffBodyCard: The {{amount}} still to come is billed today. Then record your payment as a transfer to the card.
